name: Amakusa Hisagi
source: A guest character from "[url=/v28562]Tomodachi Kara Koibito e[/url]." "Amakusa Hisagi" is a [i]seiyuu[/i] who is not allowed to reveal her face. She has been cast as the heroine in the game being created by [url=/c150926]Yukihisa[/url] and his team, and is also responsible for promoting it.
